Continent Line was the twelfth and final line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Ivan City and Little Sea, and had a total of 7 stations. It was established alongside San Shui Sand Station on September 21 2014. However, on March 10 2015, less than two months after the completion of Little Sea Station on this line, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Continent Line was the last District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled along the center of Tropic Continent in an east-west orientation.

This line was represented by the Light Blue Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 11.

At the time of its closure, this route was 5.84 km long, with a total of 7 stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is the very last line in Terracept NR to be established. In fact, the last station involved in the first section of this line (Little Sea Station) was completed less than two months before Terracept Division closed down.
  • According to the line system map at Terracept Terminal, this line had plans to extend one more station from each end, but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.
  • Ice River Station and Golden Oak Station had plans to interchange with Tropic Line and Wardring Line respectively, and reserved platforms for the Wardring Line were seen at Golden Oak Station. However, due to the closure of Terracept Division, the plans never came to fruition.
  • Unlike the other lines in Terracept Division, this line had at least two platforms for each direction in all of its stations.

History[]

  • January 17 2015: Ivan City - Little Sea

Coopol is one of the Main Districts in Los Sengas. It is located at the northernmost tip of Ingress Continent. It is temporarily managed by MasonJacques_F, and became District Number 31 on January 8 2021.

Contents

  • 2 Development

History[]

In as early as 2018, pioneering players have already reached Ingress Cape in this district, and one of the players Mura Kwan had set up a memorial at the northernmost tip of Ingress Continent and named that place Ingress Cape. This move has started a trend of players discovering new areas in Los Sengas and naming new areas that are extremely far away from Downtown. Ingress Cape is only the first of these "extremely far areas", and had attracted a lot of player attention from other players as a result.

Time flies like a rocket, and two years later, in 2020, Nazca Railway begun a series of railway pioneering projects, with the first one of them being the complete development of Glacier Line. With that, Coopol District has finally got its real name, but another player, MasonJacques_F wanted to preserve the history and name of Ingress Cape. As a result, the Ingress Cape Sub-District was born at the area near Coopol Station which was at the time unnamed.

As of today, Coopol District still used a lot of location names that are proposed by other players, and this district aims to turn itself into Los Sengas' back garden, as well as turn fantasy into reality.

Development[]

Development in Coopol District has mainly been defined as low-density terraced houses. There would not be any large shopping malls in this district and would only feature independent shops and supermarket like a typical European Village. Roads in this district would also be built in the style of rural roads designed for lower traffic flow levels. Ts district encouranges citizens to adopt more environmentally friendly modes of transport such as railways and active transport modes such as walking and cycling, and to reduce roadside air pollution, roads at a speed limit of 70 km/h or above would be built underground.

Ingress Cape Sub-District is located at the northernmost tip of Coopol District and is an important part of Coopol District. All roads and railways in this district uses this district as the Origin Point and extends southwards. The "Coopol Highways ZERO MILEPOST" is also located in this district. Moreover, this District is also home to multiple points of interest, such as Sibelius Hall, the only musical hall to feature a pipe organ in Los Sengas to date, the "Pinnacle" tower, and the historically acclaimed Ingress Cape Memorial. Sparse residential buildings could also be found along the coast.

The town center of Coopol District is located at the Snowple and Trisnow sub-districts. Sava Light Transit Line 3111 cuts through this district. Besides of terraced houses, this district also features governmental buildings, the Ookami Shrine, and the Coopol Hokuto Ferry Terminal, which is currently the only vehicular access to and from this District.

Clavis Sub-District is home to a series of leisure facilities in Coopol. This district features a Hot Springs Hotel, a camping site and training grounds for Pokémon Trainers. Moreover, the residential buildings around Key River also features a series of villas. The road which is the only external access for Tallcliff Village in Asylum starts from this sub-district.

Roads[]

Miokiwa-Sairindo[]

This road is a rural road that cuts through the west forest areas of Coopol. It starts at the "Coopol Highways ZERO MILEPOST" and passes through Watershed Voce, Snowple, Key River and ends at the north of Tallcliff Village, where this district intersects with Asylum. This road largely runs parallel with Glacier Line and is the area in Los Sengas which is developed the earliest. This road serves as an important artery for early Coopol Development.

Miokiwa-Tokaido[]

This road runs along the east coast of Coopol. It starts at the "Coopol Highways ZERO Milepost", and runs through areas such as Hokuto, Snowflake, Prunus, and ends at Fubuki Bay, where it intersects with Asylum. There are plans to connect this road with Route 18 and will serve as external access from the Coopol District in the future. Once this road is connected, it would connect to the rest of the Los Sengas road network.

Description []

Coopol Line is one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It currently starts at the east of Flask District, traverses northwards into Internal Sea, briefly skims Zootuary before reentering Internal Sea near Tooth Cliff, and passes through Ingress and Glacier.

This route is represented by Purple on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 34.

Currently, this route is km long, with a total of 10 stations.

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Start from Flask East Checkpoint at the east of Flask District, and traverse northeast to meet Origin Line, through Zootuary and the Tooth Cliff area of Internal Sea, before reaching Ingress to interchange with Luxter Line and Ingress Line at Ingress South Station, as well as Arcgo Line at Peaceful Steps Station and East Ring Line at Saber Tower Station. Completed
(Chapter: S4E6)
Continue extending northwards from Saber Tower Station to Coopol Station, interchanging with Rover Line, Snowty Line, Lingshan Line twice, Asylum Line and Arcgo Line twice, before running in parallel with Ingress Line at Coopol and reaching Coopol Station at the north of the Ingress Continent. TBC

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

Fun Facts[]

  • Prior to the establishment of this line, reserved features for this line are already seen at the Station Control Room of Coopol Station.
  • The plan of this line has gone through a few different versions, which the latest version (the 2nd version of the 2024 Plan) has been used.
    • Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline suggests that this line will traverse to Ingress South Station and the Tooth Cliff Vicinity within Internal Sea;
    • The first version of Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition sees it traverse southwest through Asylum and Snowty;
    • The second version of the 2024 Edition sees the alternation of the 2021 Outline which it extends further from Internal Sea to Flask.
  • This line will extend to Rover Line Fairlight Stationand Meadowslumber Station in the future.
  • This line marks the first instance in which Phases of a Line's Development have official names, and the name of each phase was revealed at a Memorial built in the Coopol Line Concourse of Saber Tower Station. The names of each Phase of Development in this line are listed as follows:

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after Corundum, the Crystalline form of Aluminium Oxide that is known for its toughness. The concept of its name stems from the coordinates of this station (X = +3310), which uses the same number the Nokia 3310, a phone which is also known for its toughness and durability.
  • According th Nazca Railway, the name and location of this station has already been confirmed during Phase I Development of Rover Line in S4E3.[2] However, the construction of this station has been delayed to S4E10 due to the fact that the surrounding terrain has not been smoothened.

Coubird Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is a part of the Coubird-Flask Group, and is one of the islands that are managed directly by the Los Sengas Government.

Contents

  • 3 Citations and References

Location[]

Coubird Island is located to the north of Deepond Island and the south of Droplet Island. It is a river away from Flask Island.

title: Cozywood
safeHtml:
Cozywood is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Northwesterly Side of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-03.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing
    • 2.1 Villages
    • 2.2 Public Housing (Under Planning)
    • 2.3 Home Ownership Scheme (Under Planning)
    • 2.4 Private Sector Participation Scheme (Under Planning)
  • 3 Transport
  • 4 Citations and References

History[]

Cozywood was named Ng Heung Tin, and was named after the fact that this Sub-District houses five naturally generated Villages.

When the Main Developer of Asylum began its development, there were plans to convert this area into an Industrial Estate, but due to its close proximity with the villages and its relative remoteness, the plans were ultimately scrapped, and the decision was made to abort development in this Sub-District to conserve the Villages.

Nonetheless, after Asylum completed development, the Developer of Asylum hs intentions to make use of the edges of this District and facilitate Snowty Development, as well as its future potential districts. As a result, this District was renamed "Cozywood", and will mainly build new housing.

title: Crane Island Light Rail
safeHtml:
Crane Island Light Rail is the Light Rail System on Decajotine Island. Unlike other Light Rail Systems of its kind, this light rail system does not support in-station interchanges. In other words, passengers would have to exit each station before making an interchange within the same light rail system.

Station List[]

Currently, Crane Island Light Rail has three lines with eight stations as follows:

  • Red Line:
    • NR Crane Island Station Station (Interchange with Orange Line, Nazca Railway Gondola Line, Stadow Line and Peckern Transit Northland Line, Southern Loop)
    • Central Station (Interchange with Yellow Line)
    • Crane Island Beach Station
  • Orange Line:
    • Crane Island Street Terminal Station
    • NR Crane Island Station Station (Interchange with Red Line, Nazca Railway Gondola Line, Stadow Line and Peckern Transit Northland Line, Southern Loop)
    • Crane Island Park (East) Station
  • Yellow Line:
    • Crane Island Estate Station
    • Central Station (Interchange with Orange Line)
    • Crane Island Swimming Pool Station
    • Crane Island Park (West) Station
    • Crane Plaza Station

Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Maritime Conurbation 01:20

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the permanent Down Direction Terminus of Gondola Line.
  • This Station is the first Oceanfloor Station to be an interchange station.
  • The Platform arrangement of this station resembles North Point Station of the MTR in Hong Kong. However, the design of North Point Station resembles Island Stations.[2]
  • This station is the first station since Parallel Bay Station to feature a Cross-Platform interchange.[3]

History[]

  • November 19 2018: Gondola Line and Stadow Line extends from Southeast Island Station and Abutment Island Station to this station respectively. Gondola Line completed construction, and Stadow Line is established.
  • August 27 2020: The Stadow Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[4]
  • March 5 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • September 13 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Grand Emporium.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Grand Emporium 01:44
Ledger Between Voices 02:45

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station shares structure with the Craneplaz Market and Hewiss Place buildings above, and the underground space at which this station is located is already constructed before the arrival of Nazca Railway at this station. As a result, this station is a Pseudoground Station. This Station is also the first Pseudoground Station on Akashi Line.[2]
  • The Platforms of this station are 304m long as the pre-constructed underground space is also 304m long.
  • This Station is the second station after Zootuary Station to use Sandstone as the floor tiles instead of Iron Blocks.[3]
  • This Station does not have any exits or structure on the ground level.

Future Development[]

  • This Station may serve another new line in the future.[4]

History[]

  • October 3 2021: This station began services.
  • October 15 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Fun Facts[]

  • The Charlie Line Passing tracks going through this station is open-air and uses the "Bridge Core" design similar to that used in Glacier Line and Oasis Bay Line.
  • As Wanderer Line will reach The Great Liberty Bridge after this station, the altitude of Wanderer Line Platforms are higher than that of Minecraft Line Platforms in this station.
  • A Special arrangement exists at the elevators that travels to the Wanderer Line Platforms. At the floor of Minecraft Line Platforms, this elevator provides access to both the Concourse and the Wanderer Line Platforms. However, the Concourse and the Wanderer Line Platforms are not accessible with each other when this elevator is used. This arrangement is also seen at Quillow Terrace Station.
  • With an interstation distance of 10.18 km between this station and Markost Station, it holds the record for the longest non-express train, non-veloduct interstation distance of any Standard Railway Nazca Railway line in Los Sengas Division.

History[]

  • November 25 2021: This Station began construction.
  • November 28 2021: This Station completed construction.
  • November 29 2021: This Station began services alongside Minecraft Line, but Wanderer Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • December 27 2021: Wanderer Line extends from Recuérdame Station to this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The high height of this station is contributed to the fact that motorways exist on ground level and that passageways have to be connected to the two concourses without touching the ground.
  • This Station is a representation of how two roads form a cross-shape configuration near this station, and does NOT literally refer to two rivers intersecting.[5]
  • The three concourses of this station exist in independent structures.
  • The North Concourse of this station features the first set of "two-storey" lavatories ever built in Nazca Railway.
  • After the death of the Minecraft YouTuber Technoblade, a statue built in memory of him was built near the North Concourse of this station. However, it has since been relocated to the area near the East Concourse.
  • When Xofa Line was named Xofa Crescent, the Station Number of that line was 5C-03. However, as Xofa Crescent was renamed Xofa Line due to changes in development plans, the Station Number is now 5A-03.[6]
  • When this station was constructed, the Station Number of Sparkling Line was 12-03. However, due to the construction of Enning Station and to reserve room for future Centopia development, the Station Number is now 12-04.[7]
  • With a Ceiling Height of 20m, South Concourse has one of the highest floor heights among all Concourses in Nazca Railway at the time of its construction..[8]

History[]

  • July 19 2019: This station completed construction.[9]
  • July 21 2019: This station began services alongside Xofa Line, but Sparkling Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • July 31 2019: Sparkling Line is established.
  • November 7 2020: The Sparkling Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[10]
  • May 13 2021: Due to changes in development plans, Xofa Crescent is renamed Xofa Line, and the Station Number of Xofa Line has changed.[11]
  • June 15 2021: Exit D is added to this station.[12]
  • December 31 2022: Due to the construction of Enning Station and future Centopia development, the Station Number of Sparkling Line has changed.[13]
  • December 3 2024: Exit E and the East Concourse are added to this station.[14]

title: Cyan Loop Jumping Heart
safeHtml:
Cyan Loop Jumping Heart is an NRMAD produced by Countre852 in order to celebrate birthday of the owner of PNS.

Contents

  • 1 Original Version
  • 2 Remastered Version
  • 3 Lyrics
  • 4 Citation and References

Original Version[]

"The creation of this song can be traced back to October 1 2016, when a player proposed the 'Cyan Sky Jumping Heart' version of the West Ring Line. After receiving support from other players, the song was finalized as Cyan Loop Jumping Heart, referring to the Cyan Loop Station of NR East Ring Line, and the Cantonese UTAU version was released on October 27 of the same year.

Remastered Version[]

On January 1 2023, player Creeper uploaded a remastered version of this MV, with some footage showcasing newer stations or facilities.

Lyrics[]

一心鋪設　夢與想求全實現　同行這路綫

Mining Nerf[1]　蹄邊的一角[2]　發掘了金星[3]

前途分得清　沿途找呼聲　瓶[4]內熱燙未再是無形

育樹[5]為泥土的一隅　努力去打拼

沙花[6]共上石江[7]萌芽　生成獨一的記認

無論在近西[8]義忠邨[9]　遇到難題要細緻計算

(江角[10]) 創意就是至尊　(Let's Go) 為了夢期待無厭倦　恩典賜予每天

看那微笑 My Judy[11] (不必抖顫)　圍林[12]內把夢想一一實踐

天空已幻作青和環　Jumping Heart　成就並加冕[13]

毋用到夏至　同勵互勉　為現在做好每事

愉快前進第一綫 (NR Story)　直到凝峽瑞針[14]束光[15]帽面[16]

青空約定在飛船[17]前　雲霧裡　晨暮獻心意

齊邁進沒歇止　迎向著未來　尋求那極致

Cyan Loop Station is a station on East Ring Line and Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Phantasia Metro Bonyal to Cyan Loop Line (Cyan Loop Station), Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu Downtown Loop Line (Cyan Loop Station) and Central-Yowah Railway Yowah Line (Cyan Loop Station).

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • There is a Multiple Choice Question with four choices at the East Ring Line Concourse. Wish you luck.
  • After getting the correct answer. Run as fast as you can to the Souvenir along the Station Podium.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a string.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Parkour
    • Buttons

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1.5
  • Look at the three different patterns that are situated outside the station. The first button to be press is indicated.
  • Take note of the cobblestone wall patterns on the ceiling at each corresponding button and press the buttons in the correct order.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Instant Health Potion of Healing.

Fun Facts[]

  • The East Ring Line part of this station alludes to Fanling Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.
  • After the Phoenix Line expansion, this station became the first station to be a mixed Ground and Island Station.
  • One of the Project Nazca players had created a song named after this station which is released on October 27 2016.

History[]

  • May 27 2015: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • May 6 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[5]
  • July 25 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • October 17 2018: Exit B is added to this station to connect to Central-Yowah Railway Cyan Loop Station (Then operated by Chinese Express).[7]
  • July 25 2022: This station began expansion.
  • July 26 2022: This station completed expansion. During the expansion, a new concourse, four exits and two sets of side platforms, respectively for Phoenix Line and Charlie Line emergency use, are added to this station.
  • July 27 2022: Phoenix Line extends from Luk Tsuen Station to this station.
  • September 13 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • August 11 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[9]
